$comment: Layer 1 of four (ADR 0046): what OpenID Connect Core and SD-JWT VC already spell. Not our vocabulary — a citation and the kinds this software needs to check a value against. Inventing a second name for birthdate is how two issuers end up unreadable to each other while both being right. The address members are the ones OIDC defines inside its address object, written as paths because a credential holds them apart (ADR 0031). A `legacy` word is a spelling that predates the register; it carries same_as and nothing else, and exists so credentials already issued still resolve.

claims.name: given_name
claims.meaning: The person's first name.

claims.name: family_name
claims.meaning: The person's surname.

claims.name: name
claims.meaning: The full name, as the person writes it.

claims.name: birthdate
claims.meaning: The day the person was born.

claims.name: email
claims.meaning: A mailbox the person can be reached at.

claims.name: phone_number
claims.meaning: A telephone number in E.164 form.

claims.name: address
claims.meaning: A postal address, in parts.

claims.name: gender
claims.meaning: Gender as the person states it.

claims.name: picture
claims.meaning: A picture of the person.

claims.name: middle_name
claims.meaning: Middle names, all of them, in one string.

claims.name: nickname
claims.meaning: What they are called that is not their name.

claims.name: preferred_username
claims.meaning: What they chose to be shown as. Not unique and not an identifier.

claims.name: profile
claims.meaning: URL of a profile page.

claims.name: website
claims.meaning: URL of a site of theirs.

claims.name: zoneinfo
claims.meaning: IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Bangkok.

claims.name: locale
claims.meaning: BCP47 language tag, e.g. th-TH.

claims.name: updated_at
claims.meaning: Seconds since the epoch, when this information last changed.

claims.name: email_verified
claims.meaning: Whether the issuer checked the address, not whether it works.

claims.name: phone_number_verified
claims.meaning: Whether the issuer checked the number.

claims.name: address.formatted
claims.meaning: The whole address as it would be written on an envelope, newlines and all.

claims.name: address.street_address
claims.meaning: House number, street, unit — the part before the town.

claims.name: address.locality
claims.meaning: City or town.

claims.name: address.region
claims.meaning: State, province or changwat.

claims.name: address.postal_code
claims.meaning: Postal code.

claims.name: address.country
claims.meaning: Country name or code.
